behavior: Actual original or completed saved slot ownership derives the closed Option<T> initializer; no Clone, Default or arbitrary initialization callback runs. Partial finish retains payload before its closed host custody.

One atomic account validates sampler, table-or-saved-host, copied operand and complete source origins. It protects Hs and P from numerical adoption and reserves Hs+P+N+safety, with all source accounting pins in the native scope.
Exact destination session identity accompanies the move-only submission lease; same-pool saved data copying still requires fresh preparation for a different destination session.

Native resident KV copying preserves padded/key-only/stateless cache controls, source operand order and independent alias destinations. Cold borrowed state dispatch does not invoke legacy logical estimates or reconstruct input identity.

The native paired driver retains actual source payload through the existing recovery engine, retains partial roots before later fallible work, preserves original worker errors and publishes only final destination arrays before certification.

Frozen decoder data contains no source request, receipt, live executable or inference-retention grant. Actual shared layout/input identity stays retained. Saved-to-saved copying remains valid after original session/request retirement.

The native snapshot trait routes bounded resident KV capture/copy to one sealed pair. Decoder and sampling views share that account and aggregate estimates count it once. Standalone sampling-view duplication creates only sampling destinations.

Real admitted standard/Mirostat tests verify exact and one-byte-short budgets, nonzero numerical isolation, source advancement, original executable retirement, wrong-destination rejection, late-copy failure with complete pin quarantine, and public paired copy with typed non-installing resume rejection.
review_findings: Two runtime test fixtures moved their last source registration into a rejected operation, then expected it to remain charged; keeping an independent registration clone corrected the test expectation without production changes.

The initial native paged fixture needed explicit full-attention enablement; one test used a nonexistent Array inspection method. Both fixture defects were corrected. Cold metadata tests reject RuntimeBusy when native tests run concurrently, so the validated native suite is serialized.

The independent reviews found no blocker in the inspected resident managed-payload copy path. Descriptor, handle and registry collections fit the existing bookkeeping exclusion; this does not exclude any referenced numerical buffer or semantic host payload.

Recovery capacity reserves n source handles plus at most two produced handles per copy operand before account commit. Native descriptor cloning and separate FundedWork/registry bookkeeping are not claimed allocation-free or covered by that one Vec capacity.
limits: Only resident KV decoder construction is wired into this closed paired route. Hybrid, pooling, paged, selected prediction-state and pending-prefill copying remain unfinished and reject before numerical copying; these are implementation gaps.

Fresh funded resume needs new sampler/history admission, installable decoder construction, run-local versus absolute prediction coordinates and fresh initial-input authority. A saved copy cannot be converted into runnable state or replay an old quote or receipt.

The whole-facade host preparation guard remains until controller/parser, decoder, capture/delivery and other semantic host payload copies are fully covered. The selected managed-payload account does not bound runtime/driver/allocator bookkeeping or total process/system memory.

Failed native-copy publication/uncertified scopes conservatively quarantine their remaining account and source pins. General quarantine cleanup and broader cancellation/transport paths remain unfinished.

No new released-checkpoint, distributed execution or allocator/process-memory peak measurement was performed in this increment. The full family/path bounded inference goal remains active and incomplete.
